name: 62701 · Springfield, IL
findings: ZIP 62701 (Springfield) has 140 nonprofit organizations. 74 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 70 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62701 (Springfield) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
